$Comment: How the Great Turkey fights on the hard way in (its role Harvest_Feast_Great_Turkey_HM): CAE_Harvest_Feast_Great_Turkey written out again, as the game writes its own hard bosses, with Charge ready every 8 seconds instead of 12, a peck every 1.2 to 2 seconds instead of 1.5 to 2.5, and the Harvest_Feast_Great_Turkey_Hard_Mode effect beside the souls' sheen (Harvest_Feast_Turkey_Soul_Glow), which makes every peck and every charge hit 40% harder. Each time the evaluator runs it scores the actions in its one ActionSet and runs the best: Charge sends it at a player within 14 blocks (the TargetDistance switch) with the template's telegraph (half a second locked on, a puffed-up gobble with a warning marker on the ground, then a straight run that a miss or a block ends in a daze); its weight puts it ahead of PickTarget whenever it is ready. PickTarget picks the nearest player to peck. Between those it pecks (BasicAttacks: Root_NPC_Attack_Melee with the Undead Chicken's bite, MaxRange its reach, CooldownRange the seconds between pecks, Melee_Damage's BaseDamage one peck before armour and before the hard mode). Tune pacing in each action's TimeSinceLastUsed SwitchPoint (seconds); the charge's hit, wind-up, run and daze sit in the template's parameters.

Charge.Description: Locks on, winds up and charges at the target
